coverage.note: Bush Street-Cottage Row Historic District (82000983), the smallest of the five 1980s districts, read whole. 20 residences plus a walkway and a mini-park; 18 carry both an address and a stated builder/architect/developer credit, all from two developers, The Real Estate Associates and C.L. Taylor. The appendix of 'Some Earliest Known Occupants' (13 names) is all private owner-residents and none were taken.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 2101 BUSH ST → parcel 0677035; sf-parcels has blklot 0677035 active, 2103–2103 BUSH; the 2025 roll records it as single family residential, built 1900. EAS puts 2101, 2103 BUSH ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 2101. 2101 ½ BUSH ST's coordinates fall in 4 active parcels (0677125, 0677123, 0677124, 0677122), which is what a condominium looks like in sf-parcels: one parcel per unit, none of them the building. The record was written in 1982, after the 1909 renumbering, so the number it gives is a modern number and the renumbering guard does not apply; the assessor dates the building on this parcel to 1900.
